definitions.gloss: complete defeat; total loss; utter defeat
definitions.explanation: A thorough, decisive defeat with no redeeming factors. Often used in sports and competitions.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}の{試合|しあい}は{完敗|かんぱい}だった。
examples.english: Today's match was a complete defeat.

examples.japanese: {相手|あいて}チームに{完敗|かんぱい}を{喫|きっ}した。
examples.english: We suffered a total defeat at the hands of the opposing team.

examples.japanese: {選挙|せんきょ}で{完敗|かんぱい}した{候補者|こうほしゃ}は{引退|いんたい}を{表明|ひょうめい}した。
examples.english: The candidate who suffered a crushing defeat in the election announced their retirement.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used with {喫|きっ}する (to suffer/sustain) in the formal expression {完敗|かんぱい}を{喫|きっ}する. Common in sports reporting and political commentary.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {完敗|かんぱい}を{喫|きっ}する (to suffer a complete defeat)
- {完敗|かんぱい}に{終|お}わる (to end in total defeat)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {惨敗|ざんぱい}: miserable defeat (emphasizes how devastating it was)
- {大敗|たいはい}: major defeat (large-scale loss)
- {完勝|かんしょう}: complete victory (the opposite)
